DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 53 s. 2022 June 29, 2022 HON. JOANNA S. NEMENZO City Civil Registrar City of Paranaque, Metro Manila Dear Hon. Nemenzo. This pertains to your letter dated 29 March 2022 requesting clarification concerning DILG Memorandum Circular 2013-086 and DILG and PSA Joint Memorandum Circular 2021-01 relative to their proposal to amend its fees. DILG MC No. 2013-086, "FREE-OF-CHARGE REGISTRATION OF BIRTHS, DEATHS, MARRIAGES AND FOUNDLINGS", reiterated Presidential Proclamation No. 326 entitled "DECLARING AS A NATIONAL STATE POLICY THE REGISTRATION OF BIRTHS, DEATHS, MARRIAGES AND FOUNDLINGS" which . all mayors are enjoined to comply with Presidential directive and cause the stated " immediate repeal, amendment or modification of their existing ordinances and resolutions exacting Civil Registration fees and charges." DILG and PSA JMC No. 2021-01 dated 18 October 2021, on the other hand, provided that "LCRO's shall charge fees for delayed registration of birth in an amount not exceeding Two Hundred Pesos (Php 200.00). Hence, the request for guidance on policy compliance. We submit that although Item 1 1 of DILG and PSA JMC No. 2021-01 dated 18 October 2021 provided for a repealing clause stated as "(a)ll rules and regulations, order, memoranda, or circulars inconsistent with the provisions of this Joint Memorandum Circular are hereby repealed or modified accordingly", the imposition of 200 pesos fee under Item 9 of the same JMC is specifically mentioned applicable only to delayed registration of birth alone. Thus, having no repealing effect to registrations that are not delayed, DILG MC No. 2013-086 directing free of charge registration of births, deaths, marriages and foundlings, remains applicable to new registrations. In view of the foregoing, both policies are to be implemented and construed harmoniously. "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-3464

We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: INGAN Underse etary for Local Government LLLS/RPB/LRALL kb copy furnished: MARIA LOURDES L.
